comment: Shared vectors for the module SQL guard (#1444 H6). tools/modules/test_rustycore_module.py and wow-database's module_sql tests both read this file, so the compose-time (Python) and apply-time (Rust) guards cannot drift. prefix is the one for module id example.milestones.
